facts.text: Listen up, X-Force. Dinner is mandatory and so is wearing pants. Peter, that means you.
facts.why: Not found among Wade's lines in any source I opened. It is printed in quote marks as dialogue. As a note Wade might write it is true to Peter, who has no powers and joins X-Force after seeing an ad.
